run-fast.prompt: Educational running illustration, one single pose (not a sequence or collage). Reference attached canonical athlete for exact identity: faceless bald white/light-grey anatomical athlete, fine dark contours, smooth neutral featureless pelvis, white trainers. Match the second attached image's rendering style exactly. Fast running for tempo, intervals and races, fixed side view, athlete facing right, in the flight phase with both feet off the ground: a long stride, the front knee driven high with the front thigh rising toward horizontal and the lower leg swinging forward; the rear leg extended behind after push-off, its foot below hip height. Strong arm drive: the front hand rises toward chin height with the elbow bent about 90 degrees, the rear elbow driven back past the torso. Torso tall with a slight forward lean from the ankles, relaxed hands. Same identity, scale and camera as an easy-running pose. Muscle colours: strongest purple on the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings and calves; pale lilac on the hip flexors and core; every other muscle white-grey. Pure solid black background. Square canvas, the whole figure filling about 80% of the height with even margins, both feet fully inside the frame. One person only. No floor line, track, road, shadow, scenery, motion lines, labels, text, logos or arrows.

rest-walk.prompt: Educational fitness illustration, one single pose (not a sequence or collage). Reference attached canonical athlete for exact identity: faceless bald white/light-grey anatomical athlete, fine dark contours, smooth neutral featureless pelvis with no shorts or clothing, white trainers.
